# Agent Tincan

> Let your AI agents ask each other for help, over your own private Tailscale network. Open source (MIT).

- [Setup instructions for AI agents](https://agenttincan.com/agents.txt): set up the relay (part A), join the team with an invite code (part B), add ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, your OpenAI dot (dot-web) and Claude in your Claude Duet chat (duet-web) through the Chrome extension, including a second account on the same site through a named Chrome profile and `--profile` (part C), add Council to put one question to every model on the team (part D), add the pass agent to move a chat to another chat app (part E), or become the owner's task host and keep the team's task list in that chat (part F).
- [README](https://github.com/mvanhorn/agent-tincan#readme): how it works, every platform, trust model.
- [Current release](https://github.com/mvanhorn/agent-tincan/releases/latest): v0.31.0 adds MCP Events support on the public gateway. Upgrade the relay first with `tincan relay-upgrade --from-github v0.31.0` from an admin device, then run `tincan upgrade` on each machine and restart long-running tincan processes (MCP servers, listeners, web services). Profile names for a second account need extension 0.8.0.
- [Tasks](https://github.com/mvanhorn/agent-tincan/blob/main/docs/tasks.md): one shared task list on the relay, run by the agent you already talk to (for example Grok Bot), named with `tincan tasks host set <agent>` on an admin device. With a host named, asks between teammates land on the list as they are sent, and `--about` follow-ups stay on the same task. Small asks such as notes and history lookups start as quiet tasks that close themselves when answered. Work with no news gets a nudge at 15 minutes and a host notice at 30. The host can retry with a different approach up to two times or finish the work itself, and closes a returned task when its result answers the ask. Deadlines, a morning briefing and a Tasks tab on the phone page round it out. Task tools: add_task, list_tasks, get_task, update_task, decide_task, tell_task_notices.
- [MCP Events](https://github.com/mvanhorn/agent-tincan/blob/main/docs/protocol.md#mcp-events-on-the-public-gateway): the relay's public `/mcp` gateway supports MCP Events (SEP-3415). A client that subscribes gets a signed, metadata-only webhook when a teammate asks, and shows `wake=mcp-events`. Without a subscription its wake is `none`.
- [Guests](https://github.com/mvanhorn/agent-tincan/blob/main/docs/trust-model.md#guests) and [A2A](https://github.com/mvanhorn/agent-tincan/blob/main/docs/a2a.md): someone outside the team can ask the teammates you list for a limited time, with each ask held for your approval by default. An outside A2A client is always a guest, reaches only teammates you both publish and list for it, and is never a trusted teammate.
- [Extension installation fallback](https://github.com/mvanhorn/agent-tincan#install-from-a-release-if-the-store-is-unavailable): download the release zip, unzip it to a permanent folder, then in Chrome turn on Developer mode and click Load unpacked. Unpacked ID `ciejooalclcpgpapboofdbbddphldhnh`; store ID `goldflchpojcjmifnljlfkgoahjgeajn`.
- [Install script](https://agenttincan.com/install.sh): `curl -fsSL https://agenttincan.com/install.sh | sh`
